title: Layer-wise Derivative Controlled Networks Achieve Competitive Accuracy and Gradient Stability Across Data Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2606.07908v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Derivative-controlled networks based on ChainzRule (CR) combine cubic polynomial layers with a lightweight forward-mode per-layer Jacobian penalty (DREG). In this second paper of a multi-part series, we evaluate the generalization properties of CR across data regimes.   We ablate the shape of the DREG coefficient schedule, demonstrating that the optimal annealing range depends on representation noise. On the Pima Diabetes dataset, CR achieves strong low-data performance and maintains a consistent accuracy advantage over baselines from 5\% to 100\% training data, supported by exceptionally stable gradient tail ratios ($\sim$1.01--1.02 vs. 1.07--1.09 for ReLU networks). Extensions to SST-5 show competitive or superior results in both frozen-embedding and BERT fine-tuned regimes, including outperforming prior BERT baselines despite substantially less training data. translated_title: 逐层导数控制网络在不同数据规模下实现有竞争力的准确率与梯度稳定性
translated_abstract: 基于ChainzRule（CR）的导数控制网络将三次多项式层与轻量级前向模式的逐层雅可比惩罚（DREG）相结合。作为本系列多篇文章中的第二篇，我们评估了CR在不同数据规模下的泛化特性。我们对DREG系数调度的形状进行了消融实验，证明最优退火范围取决于表示噪声。在Pima糖尿病数据集上，CR在低数据量下表现出色，并在5%至100%训练数据的全范围内始终保持对基线的一致准确率优势，这得益于极其稳定的梯度尾部比率（约1.01–1.02，而ReLU网络为1.07–1.09）。在SST-5数据集上的扩展实验显示，无论是在冻结嵌入还是BERT微调模式下，CR都取得了具有竞争力或更优的结果，包括在训练数据大幅减少的情况下仍超越了先前的BERT基线。这些结果具有统计显著性：CR取得了更优的准确率
tldr: 提出基于ChainzRule的导数控制网络，通过三次多项式层结合轻量级逐层雅可比惩罚（DREG），在从低数据到全量数据的各种数据规模下均实现了优于基线的准确率和极其稳定的梯度表现，并在SST-5上以大幅更少的训练数据超越了现有BERT基线。
en_tdlr: ChainzRule-based derivative-controlled networks combining cubic polynomial layers with a lightweight per-layer Jacobian penalty (DREG) achieve consistently superior accuracy and exceptionally stable gradient tail ratios across all data regimes, outperforming prior BERT baselines on SST-5 with substantially less training data.
